name: ultralayer
description: Realtime market intelligence for AI agents: what changed, who is affected, and what to watch next. One suite covering news, events, guidance, filing changes, sentiment, stakeholders, and alerts. Information-efficient responses with evidence for every result. First-class point-in-time safety for backtests. Pairs well with web search and a market-data API. All data is our own.
